symbols.name: DashboardProfilingViewModel
symbols.summary: Contains the server-rendered state and endpoint paths for the Profiling dashboard.

symbols.name: Status
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the current feature and active-session status.

symbols.name: Sessions
symbols.summary: Gets or sets stored sessions in provider order.

symbols.name: SelectedSession
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the complete selected-session data.

symbols.name: SelectedNode
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the selected-node timeline.

symbols.name: SessionKey
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the selected public session key.

symbols.name: NodeKey
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the selected public node key.

symbols.name: SnapshotKey
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the explicitly selected snapshot key; null follows the latest snapshot.

symbols.name: Error
symbols.summary: Gets or sets a safe dashboard loading error.

symbols.name: RefreshIntervalMilliseconds
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the configured refresh interval in milliseconds.

symbols.name: PagePath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the profiling page path.

symbols.name: ContentPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the refreshable content path.

symbols.name: StartPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the start action path.

symbols.name: StopPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the stop action path.

symbols.name: SnapshotPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the manual snapshot action path.

symbols.name: GarbageCollectionPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the manual garbage-collection action path.

symbols.name: StressPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the fixed host-local stress action path.

symbols.name: MarkerPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the phase-marker action path.

symbols.name: MetadataPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the metadata update path.

symbols.name: DeleteSessionPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the selected-session deletion path.

symbols.name: DeleteUnpinnedPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the bulk unpinned-session deletion path.

symbols.name: ClearPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the complete-store reset path.

symbols.name: ComparePath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the raw snapshot comparison path.

symbols.name: AnalyzePath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the deterministic analysis path.

symbols.name: NodeExportPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the selected-node raw JSON export path.

symbols.name: SessionExportPath
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the import-compatible complete-session JSON export path.

symbols.name: SessionArchivePath

symbols.name: SessionPerfettoPath
